case_name: Army Welfare Housing Organisation vs Logix Infratech Pvt. Ltd
facts_of_case: The plaintiff seeks to have the defendant's written statement condoned for delay in filing.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking condonation of delay in filing written statement must place on record any document to show correspondence with the other parties at the email address upon which service has been effected.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiff shall place on record any document to show correspondence with 75 members at the email address upon which service has been effected particulars if any correspondence has been received by him from the 75 members through the said email ID.

legal_principles.principle: A party must verify the authenticity of a digitally signed order and provide evidence to support its claims.
